name: haiku-compact
description: /compact haiku: compact the conversation with a cheap model, so after a cold prompt cache your main model re-caches a short summary instead of the whole transcript. Never compacts on its own; a status-line hint says when the cache has gone cold.

summaryModel.title: Summary model
summaryModel.description: Model that writes the summary, and the word after /compact that selects it (alias or full id).

keepMessages.title: Messages kept verbatim
keepMessages.description: How many recent messages to keep word for word after the summary.

hintIdleMinutes.title: Cold-cache hint after (minutes)
hintIdleMinutes.description: Show the status-line hint after this many idle minutes; match your prompt-cache TTL (5 or 60). 0 turns the idle hint off.

hintMinTokens.title: Cold-cache hint minimum tokens
hintMinTokens.description: Only hint when the context is at least this many tokens.
